issues.legal_issue: A holder of a village grant with exemption from land revenue cannot claim compensation for losing assessment collected from inferior holders when the land is made subject to full assessment payable to the government.
material_facts: The grants conveyed the villages and their soil with exemption from land revenue; they were not grants of land revenue alone.

Before abolition, inferior holders paid rent or settlement assessment to the grant holders, and the survey settlement did not change the character of the grants or make the inferior holders liable to pay the government directly.
The abolition measure made the lands liable to full assessment and made inferior holders liable to pay that assessment directly to the government.
The grant holders sought compensation for losing the right to collect assessment from inferior holders.
issues.conclusion: The claim for compensation was barred because, in substance, it arose from making previously revenue-exempt land subject to full assessment.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 2(1)(e), 5(1) and 5(2)(b) of the Bombay Personal Inams Abolition Act, 1952, a grant of a village with revenue exemption is distinct from a grant of land revenue, and inferior holders become liable to pay assessment to the government. Although section 17(1) provides for compensation for certain abolished rights where compensation is otherwise unprovided, section 17(5) bars compensation on the ground that previously wholly or partly revenue-exempt inam land has been made subject to full assessment. The loss of the right to collect assessment from inferior holders was, in substance, a consequence of that change.

predicates.statutory_compensation_claim_in_land_gra: A holder sought compensation in a proceeding concerning the abolition of rights arising from a land grant.
predicates.village_grant_with_revenue_exemption: The grant conveyed a village or its soil and exempted it wholly or partly from land revenue, rather than granting land revenue alone.
predicates.inferior_holders_paid_assessment_to_gran: People holding land under the grant holder paid rent or settlement assessment to that holder.
predicates.land_made_subject_to_full_assessment_pay: The abolition measure made the land subject to full assessment payable to the government, including by the inferior holders.

issues.definition: When a compensation claim in a land-grant abolition proceeding concerns a revenue-exempt village grant, inferior holders previously paid assessment to the grant holder, and the land is made subject to full assessment payable to the government, the claim for compensation for losing that collection right is barred.

issues.legal_issue: Compensation is unavailable for alleged losses of forfeiture and reversion rights when the claimant does not establish that those rights were exercised or prove a loss capable of assessment.
material_facts: The grant holders also sought compensation for the loss of alleged rights to forfeit inferior holders’ tenancies and to obtain reversion of the lands.
They produced no evidence of exercising those rights and did not identify an instance in which they had done so.
They supplied no material by which any loss from the alleged rights’ extinction could be valued.
issues.conclusion: The claim for compensation for the alleged forfeiture and reversion rights was denied because the grant holders failed to establish the rights’ exercise or any assessable loss.
issues.legal_principle: Section 17(1) of the Bombay Personal Inams Abolition Act, 1952 provides for compensation for certain abolished rights where compensation is not otherwise provided. The Court declined compensation for the alleged forfeiture and reversion rights because the claimants did not establish that the rights had been exercised or provide material showing a loss that could be valued; it was also not shown that the measure had taken those rights away.

predicates.statutory_compensation_claim_in_land_gra: A holder sought compensation in a proceeding concerning the abolition of rights arising from a land grant.
predicates.compensation_sought_for_forfeiture_or_re: The claimant sought compensation for losing an asserted right to forfeit a tenancy or obtain reversion of land.
predicates.no_evidence_of_exercising_those_rights: The claimant provided no evidence of having exercised the asserted forfeiture or reversion rights.
predicates.no_evidence_of_assessable_loss: The claimant provided no material showing a loss from those rights that could be assessed or valued.

issues.definition: When a compensation claim in a land-grant abolition proceeding concerns asserted forfeiture or reversion rights, but there is no evidence that the claimant exercised those rights or suffered an assessable loss, compensation for those rights is denied.
